description: Use this when the person picks one of the Pugi logos shown in this conversation (in the card or in words, such as "the second one"). Saves that logo for their business and returns the summary a website or app will be built from: show it and wait. Call again with correction when they change anything in the summary. Draws and buys nothing.

correction.description: The person's correction to the summary, in their own words.

logo_id.description: The logo_id of the picked logo, from the last logo result.
